csv_project_name: CEI for I-66 EB and WB Superstructure Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The Virginia Department of Transportation is seeking expressions of interest from consulting engineering firms who wish to be considered to provide Construction Engineering and Inspection (CEI) services for the construction phase that will provide the full replacement of the Interstate 66 bridge over Broad Run in Fauquier County. The bridge is located at mile marker 36, just west of the Prince William County line, and carries both eastbound and westbound traffic.
